M1_runtime_tokenization_identity.note: load-bearing: if this fails the band allocation differs between models and no comparison is valid

M3_cross_cohort_consistency.note: D5 measured these on a DIFFERENT cohort; agreement is expected to be close but not exact. A gross divergence would indicate a capture bug.

M4_band_mass_normalisation.note: asserted inside the capture (masses sum to 1 within 1e-5); flagged, not counted as evidence

M5_base_checkpoint_identity.note: the absent position table is an architecture fact and is flagged; the MLM head presence is a real checkpoint check
